I would like to share my Google Calendar for Summoners War Events, just made this maybe an hour ago, due to the amount of events happening these days.

https://www.google.com/calendar/embed?src=ipl2st7sr8irtakb2o2siotopc%40group.calendar.google.com&ctz=America/Los_Angeles

HOW TO USE

1.Copy + Paste the url above to your browser

2.Open http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_tz_database_time_zones , and look for your timezone or area, for example :

  • Indonesia (Jakarta) : Asia/Jakarta

  • Los Angeles : America/Los_Angeles

  • Sydney : Australia/Sydney

  • London : Europe/London

3.Replace the content after "ctz=" on the calendar URL, for example :

  • Indonesia : https://www.google.com/calendar/embed?src=ipl2st7sr8irtakb2o2siotopc%40group.calendar.google.com&ctz=Asia/Jakarta

  • Los Angeles : https://www.google.com/calendar/embed? src=ipl2st7sr8irtakb2o2siotopc%40group.calendar.google.com&ctz=America/Los_Angeles

  • Sydney : https://www.google.com/calendar/embed?src=ipl2st7sr8irtakb2o2siotopc%40group.calendar.google.com&ctz=Australia/Sydney

  • London : https://www.google.com/calendar/embed?src=ipl2st7sr8irtakb2o2siotopc%40group.calendar.google.com&ctz=Europe/London

  • Buenos Aires : https://www.google.com/calendar/embed?src=ipl2st7sr8irtakb2o2siotopc%40group.calendar.google.com&ctz=America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires

4.There you go, a personalized Summoners War Event Calendar for your own timezone :D

BUT WAIT, THERE'S MORE

If you are using a Google Calendar (If you don't, go make one :p), you can integrate this calendar to your own calendar.

Click on the bottom right button on the Calendar Screen, a "+Google Calendar" button should be there

When you do add the calendar, it will ask to adjust automatically to your own timezone, just accept the auto adjust and you're all set.

I will try to update the calendar every time a new event pops up.

I hope this is useful, Good luck on the Events, and please tell me if there are some mistakes.
